capabilities.description: Consume only Gene 0 exports declared by the capability manifest and verified by SHA-256 before activation.
Keep canonical network policy snapshots locally without overwriting descendant identity or local learning policy.
Validate local critical JSON state and inherited core state before an inherited release is committed.
Preserve descendant-specific node identity, model profile, attestations, learning policy and specialist repair logic.

activation_rule: download -> verify hash -> stage -> validate -> commit
rollback_rule: never install a lower semantic release version than the locally recorded Gene 0 release
